title: DynamicBorder
description: This mod lets you fully customize the Minecraft world border - set its starting size, adjust its growth or shrink speed per player, and make your world feel truly alive and responsive.
body:
# 🌐 DynamicBorder - Mod

A Smarter, Living World Border

DynamicBorder gives you full control over the Minecraft world border and turns it into a dynamic gameplay mechanic instead of a static limit.
![dynamicborder-banner1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5273b39bb726a90583f378bf20328224829950a7_0.webp)

Customize how your world expands or contracts over time, whether you want a harsh survival challenge, a progressive exploration experience, or a multiplayer-driven world that grows with your community.

## ✨ Features:
- 📏 Custom Starting Size:
  - Define exactly how large (or small) your world should begin. Perfect for challenge maps, SMP progression, or controlled exploration.


- ⬆️⬇️ Growth & Shrink Behavior:
  - Choose whether the border should grow, shrink, or stay still.
  - You can make the world slowly open up… or close in for increased tension.


- 👥 Blocks per Player per Minute:
  - The border can react to your player count!
  - Set how many blocks the border expands or contracts per player per minute, allowing multiplayer servers to scale automatically as people join or leave.


- ⚙️ Base Movement (Global Growth/Shrink):
  - Add a constant growth or shrink value that affects the border at all times - with or without players contributing additional movement.


- 🕒 Player-Dependent Activity:
  - To keep things fair and performance-friendly, the border only moves while at least one player is online.
  - No offline inflation of your world!


## 🧩 Why Use Dynamic Border?

- Great for SMP progression
- Perfect for adventure maps and survival challenges
- Ensures controlled exploration
- Adds tension and strategy
- Fully configurable to fit any playstyle and of course everything can be changed via commands during a game

Whether you want your world to slowly unfold like a story or tighten around players like a survival cage… Dynamic Border gives you the tools.
